wikisource-bulkocr-feedback-no-results: OCR ma uusan soo saarin wax qoraal ah bogagga la doortay. Adeegga OCR waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan si ku meelgaar ah u shaqaynayn. Fadlan mar kale isku day goor dambe.
wikisource-bulkocr-feedback-safety-banne: Sii wad ficilka oo keliya haddii aad ogtahay waxa aad samaynayso, maadaama uu saameynayo bogag badan oo buugga ah.
wikisource-bulkocr-ocr-progress: Horumarka OCR: $1/$2 bogag ayaa la farsameeyay
wikisource-bulkocr-saving-progress: Kaydinta natiijooyinka OCR: $1/$2 bogag ayaa la kaydiyay
